notes: The report opens mid-chain with «قال محمد بن شهاب» (Zuhri speaks; no earlier chain is written here); the reading takes the chain as the text writes it.
«قال أبو سلمة وهى الأوثان» is Abu Salama's gloss on the Qur'anic word, not a link.
The saying is Jabir's account of the Prophet's words; the Prophet is the end.
